issues.description: Medium and hard examples lack references to real olympiad problems (only typical examples provided).
Example 7 uses derivatives, which may be advanced for some 11th grade regional participants (though acceptable).

strengths: Full coverage of required structure with clear sections and CHECK points.
Mathematically correct solutions and proofs verified with concrete cases.
Effective pedagogical approach in common mistakes section.
suggestions: Add specific olympiad references for medium/hard examples (e.g., 'BMO 2010, P2').
Consider an alternative solution without derivatives for Example 7 (e.g., monotonicity through differences).
verdict_reasoning: Article is mathematically sound and fully structured but loses points for lacking real olympiad references in practice examples. Still exceeds approval threshold due to pedagogical strengths.
